# Finance Academy by Aakash

> A free learning hub that takes a beginner from zero to confident about mutual funds, RBI, SEBI, and investing in India. Education only, not investment advice.

Built by Aakash Hegde, a B.Voc BFSI student at TISS Mumbai.

## What it teaches

- Mutual funds: 7 levels from basics to advanced, with quizzes after each level
- How NAV, SIP, expense ratio, and fund types work
- RBI and SEBI: what they do and why they matter to investors
- Asset classes: equity, debt, gold, and more
- 80-term finance glossary in simple words
- SIP calculator to plan monthly investing
- Blog with finance explainers and analysis
- AI tutor that answers finance questions
- Certificate after passing the final exam

## Who it is for

- Beginners in India who want to understand mutual funds and investing
- Students learning banking and financial services (BFSI)
- Anyone who wants free, simple finance education with no sign-in and no fees

## Important notes

- Education only. The site never recommends specific funds or shares to buy or sell.
- Free forever. No login needed to learn, no fees.
